sampling.gallery_star_curation: For introductory image/classification cards only, require the two-component proper-motion significance to be at least 4. This is not a one-dimensional four-sigma probability. Task 2 stars have no astrometric cut.
sampling.notes: Development sources plus benchmark-excluded stellar parent; no selector cuts on stars. Labeled M60 example reused from already-public v1 only.

grading_policy: Use secure catalog reference classes as external evidence, not a guarantee that the supplied Gaia/JPEG data uniquely determine class. Assess evidence notes, uncertainty, confidence, and citations manually. A justified uncertain answer may receive full reasoning credit. No automatic final grade or numerical pass threshold is assigned; Task 3 has no supplied solution.
